title: High Spirits at New York City Center #highspirits #encoresnycc #phill...
transcript: Nothing says “musical theatre comedy” like a love triangle where one of them is dead. In High Spirits, the kooky show marking the start of this year's Encores series, Charles and his wife Ruth are haunted by his former lover Elvira when a living room seance brings her back from the dead. This production was my first exposure to the 1964 musical, and while I can see why it couldn't make as big of a splash as some of the other shows that year like Hello Dolly! or Funny Girl, it's still a solid show and a perfect candidate for Encores. The stellar cast they've assembled features Phillipa Soo, Steven Pasquale, and Katrina Lenk in the lead roles, and everyone is given plenty of genuinely comedic material to chew on. For a musical, the book to music ratio is quite high, and the actors were definitely on book, at least during last night's dress. In the spirit of Encores though, they leaned into this in the best way possible. Case in point: Andrea Martin reading lines off of her ouija board. All in all, a delightful time. While I wouldn't expect to see a broadway revival of High Spirits anytime soon, it's definitely worth seeing at City Center. With that, another program for my collection.
